2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Update Profile
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the State field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the ZIP Code field blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the ZIP Code field blank
2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Update Profile
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the ZIP Code field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Phone Number field blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the Phone Number field blank
2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Update Profile
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Phone Number field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit with all required fields empty

test_cases.test_case: Enter a phone number with leading/trailing whitespace

test_cases.test_case: Request a new card with valid details
steps: 1. Select <Card Type> from the Card Type dropdown
2. Select <Account to Link> from the Account dropdown
3. Enter a complete Shipping Address in the Shipping Address field
4. Click Request Card
test_cases.expected_result: Card request submitted successfully. Tracking ID shown.

2. Enter <New Spending Limit> in the New Spending Limit field
3. Enter <optional dates> in the Travel Notice fields
4. Select <Card Status> from the Card Status dropdown

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Card Type field blank and submit

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Account to Link field blank and submit

2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Request Card
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Account to Link field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Shipping Address field blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the Shipping Address field blank
2. Fill all other required fields

test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Shipping Address field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Submit the card request form with all fields empty

test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Card Type, Account to Link, and Shipping Address fields indicating they are required

test_cases.test_case: Enter a non-numeric value in the New Spending Limit field and submit

test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the New Spending Limit field indicating it must be a number

test_cases.test_case: Enter an invalid date range in the Travel Notice fields and submit
steps: 1. Enter <end date before start date> in the Travel Notice fields
2. Fill all other required fields

test_cases.test_case: Select an invalid Card Status transition and submit

2. Select <invalid status> in the Card Status field

test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Card Status field indicating the status transition is not allowed

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to update controls without filling required fields
steps: 1. Open the Update Controls form
2. Leave all required fields blank
3. Click Update Controls
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the required fields indicating they are required

test_cases.test_case: Submit card request with incomplete address
preconditions: User is on the Manage Cards page
steps: 1. Select 'Debit' as Card Type
2. Select an Account to Link
3. Leave Shipping Address blank
4. Click 'Request Card'
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission is blocked; inline error shows 'Shipping Address is required.'

test_cases.test_case: Update controls with spending limit at policy maximum
preconditions: User is on the Manage Cards page
steps: 1. Select an Existing Card from the dropdown
2. Enter the maximum allowed New Spending Limit
3. Click 'Update Controls'
test_cases.expected_result: Card controls updated successfully.

test_cases.test_case: Update controls with spending limit above policy maximum
preconditions: User is on the Manage Cards page
steps: 1. Select an Existing Card from the dropdown
2. Enter a New Spending Limit above the maximum allowed
3. Click 'Update Controls'
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission is blocked; inline error shows 'Spending limit exceeds policy maximum.'

test_cases.test_case: Update controls with invalid travel notice dates
preconditions: User is on the Manage Cards page
steps: 1. Select an Existing Card from the dropdown
2. Enter New Spending Limit
3. Enter a Travel Notice start date in the past
4. Click 'Update Controls'
test_cases.expected_result: Form submission is blocked; inline error shows 'Travel notice start date cannot be in the past.'

test_cases.test_case: Execute a successful trade
steps: 1. Enter 'AAPL' in the Fund Symbol field
2. Enter '10' in the Quantity field
3. Select <Funding Account> from the Funding Account dropdown
4. Click 'Execute Trade'
test_cases.expected_result: Trade executed successfully. Order ID is displayed.

test_cases.test_case: Create a successful recurring investment plan
preconditions: Sufficient balance in the funding account
steps: 1. Enter 'AAPL' in the Fund Symbol field
2. Enter '100' in the Contribution Amount field
3. Select 'Weekly' from the Frequency dropdown
4. Enter a future date in the Start Date field
5. Select <Funding Account> from the Funding Account dropdown
6. Click 'Create Plan'
test_cases.expected_result: Plan created successfully.

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Quantity field blank and submit the trade funds form
steps: 1. Leave the Quantity field blank
2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Execute Trade
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Quantity field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Enter a negative value in the Quantity field and submit the trade funds form
steps: 1. Enter <negative quantity> in the Quantity field
2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Execute Trade
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Quantity field indicating it must be greater than zero

test_cases.test_case: Select a funding account with insufficient balance and submit the recurring investment plan form
steps: 1. Fill all fields in the recurring investment plan form
2. Select a funding account with insufficient balance
3. Click Create Plan
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Funding Account field indicating insufficient balance

test_cases.test_case: Enter a past date in the Start Date field and submit the recurring investment plan form
steps: 1. Enter <past date> in the Start Date field
2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Create Plan
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Start Date field indicating 'Start date must be in the future'

test_cases.test_case: Submit the trade funds form with all fields empty
steps: 1. Leave all fields in the trade funds form blank
2. Click Execute Trade
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation errors appear on the Action, Fund Symbol, Quantity, and Funding Account fields indicating they are required

test_cases.test_case: Enter an invalid Fund Symbol in the trade funds form and submit
steps: 1. Enter <invalid fund symbol> in the Fund Symbol field
2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Execute Trade
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Fund Symbol field indicating it does not exist

test_cases.test_case: Enter a contribution amount below the minimum in the recurring investment plan form and submit
steps: 1. Enter <amount below minimum> in the Contribution Amount field
2. Fill all other required fields
3. Click Create Plan
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Contribution Amount field indicating it must meet the minimum

test_cases.test_case: Check trade quantity at minimum valid boundary

test_cases.expected_result: Inline error displayed indicating quantity must be greater than zero

3. Select 'Weekly' in the Frequency field
4. Enter tomorrow's date in the Start Date field

test_cases.test_case: Check recurring investment plan start date not in the future

steps: 1. Enter a valid Fund Symbol in the Fund Symbol field

4. Enter yesterday's date in the Start Date field

test_cases.test_case: Change Password with valid inputs
steps: 1. Navigate to the Security Settings page
2. Enter <valid current password> in the Current Password field
3. Enter <valid new password> in the New Password field
4. Enter <valid new password> in the Confirm New Password field
5. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Password changed successfully.

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Current Password field blank and submit
steps: 1. Leave the Current Password field blank
2. Fill New Password and Confirm New Password with valid values
3. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Current Password field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the New Password field blank and submit
steps: 1. Enter a valid Current Password
2. Leave the New Password field blank
3. Fill Confirm New Password with a valid value
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the New Password field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Confirm New Password field blank and submit
steps: 1. Enter a valid Current Password
2. Fill New Password with a valid value
3. Leave the Confirm New Password field blank
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Confirm New Password field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Enter a weak New Password and submit
steps: 1. Enter a valid Current Password
2. Enter <weak password> in the New Password field
3. Fill Confirm New Password with the same weak password
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors highlight the appropriate fields; New Password field displays an error: 'Password does not meet strong-password policy'

test_cases.test_case: Enter non-matching New Password and Confirm New Password and submit
steps: 1. Enter a valid Current Password
2. Enter <valid new password> in the New Password field
3. Enter <different password> in the Confirm New Password field
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors highlight the appropriate fields; Confirm New Password field displays an error: 'Passwords do not match'

test_cases.test_case: Enter an invalid Current Password and submit
steps: 1. Enter <invalid current password> in the Current Password field
2. Enter a valid New Password
3. Fill Confirm New Password with the same valid New Password
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors highlight the appropriate fields; Current Password field displays an error: 'Current Password is invalid'

test_cases.test_case: Test minimum length for New Password
preconditions: User is on the Security Settings page
steps: 1. Enter valid Current Password in the Current Password field
2. Enter exactly <minimum length> characters in the New Password field
3. Enter the same <minimum length> characters in the Confirm New Password field
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; password is changed as per the strong-password policy

test_cases.test_case: Test one character below minimum length for New Password
preconditions: User is on the Security Settings page
steps: 1. Enter valid Current Password in the Current Password field
2. Enter <minimum length - 1> characters in the New Password field
3. Enter the same <minimum length - 1> characters in the Confirm New Password field
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors highlight the New Password and Confirm New Password fields indicating the password is too short

test_cases.test_case: Test long string input for Current Password
preconditions: User is on the Security Settings page
steps: 1. Enter a long string (200+ characters) in the Current Password field
2. Enter valid New Password in the New Password field
3. Enter the same valid New Password in the Confirm New Password field
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Validation errors highlight the Current Password field indicating the input is too long

test_cases.test_case: Test special characters in New Password
preconditions: User is on the Security Settings page
steps: 1. Enter valid Current Password in the Current Password field
2. Enter a New Password with special characters in the New Password field
3. Enter the same New Password with special characters in the Confirm New Password field
4. Click Change Password
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; password is changed as special characters are allowed

test_cases.test_case: Send a message with valid input
steps: 1. Enter <valid subject> in the Subject field
2. Select <valid category> from the Category dropdown
3. Enter <valid message body> in the Message Body field
4. (Optional) Attach a <valid file type>
5. Click Send Message
test_cases.expected_result: Message sent successfully. with a ticket ID

test_cases.test_case: Request a callback with valid input
steps: 1. Select <valid reason for call> from the Reason for Call dropdown
2. Enter <next business day> in the Preferred Date field
3. Select <valid time window> from the Preferred Time Window dropdown
4. Verify Phone Number field is pre-filled and editable
5. Click Request Callback
test_cases.expected_result: Callback request submitted.

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Subject field blank and submit the message form
steps: 1. Leave the Subject field blank
2. Fill in the Category, Message Body, and Attachment fields with valid data
3. Click Send Message
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Subject field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Leave the Message Body field blank and submit the message form
steps: 1. Leave the Message Body field blank
2. Fill in the Subject, Category, and Attachment fields with valid data
3. Click Send Message
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Message Body field indicating it is required

test_cases.test_case: Select an invalid attachment type and submit the message form
steps: 1. Fill in the Subject, Category, and Message Body fields with valid data
2. Attach a file with an invalid type
3. Click Send Message
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears indicating the attachment type is not allowed

test_cases.test_case: Select a Preferred Date that is not the next business day and submit the callback form
steps: 1. Select a Preferred Date that is today
2. Fill in the Reason for Call, Preferred Time Window, and Phone Number fields with valid data
3. Click Request Callback
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Preferred Date field indicating it must be at least the next business day

test_cases.test_case: Enter an invalid phone number format and submit the callback form
steps: 1. Fill in the Reason for Call, Preferred Date, and Preferred Time Window fields with valid data
2. Enter an invalid phone number in the Phone Number field
3. Click Request Callback
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation error appears on the Phone Number field indicating it must be a valid phone number format

test_cases.test_case: Test subject length at minimum allowed characters
steps: 1. Select 'Account' from the Category dropdown
2. Enter exactly <minimum allowed length> characters in the Subject field
3. Enter valid content in the Message Body
4. Click 'Send Message'
test_cases.expected_result: Form submits successfully; entity is created with the <minimum allowed length>

test_cases.test_case: Test subject length below minimum allowed characters
steps: 1. Select 'Technical' from the Category dropdown
2. Enter <one unit below minimum> characters in the Subject field
3. Enter valid content in the Message Body
4. Click 'Send Message'
test_cases.expected_result: Subject displays an error indicating the value is below the minimum allowed

test_cases.test_case: Test preferred date at minimum allowed (next business day)
steps: 1. Select a Reason for Call from the dropdown
2. Enter the next business day in the Preferred Date field
3. Enter valid time in the Preferred Time Window
4. Enter a valid Phone Number
5. Click 'Request Callback'
test_cases.expected_result: Callback request submitted.

test_cases.test_case: Test preferred date below minimum allowed (today)
steps: 1. Select a Reason for Call from the dropdown
2. Enter today's date in the Preferred Date field
3. Enter valid time in the Preferred Time Window
4. Enter a valid Phone Number
5. Click 'Request Callback'
test_cases.expected_result: Preferred Date displays an error indicating it must be at least the next business day
